browse_api.description:
Syreeta – Stevie Wonder Presents Syreeta

Label: Motown Records

Catalog #: M6-808S1

Released: 1974

Produced entirely by Stevie Wonder, this classic Motown soul album features Stevie's signature production, synthesizers, and songwriting alongside Syreeta's beautiful vocals.

Includes fan favorites:

  • I'm Goin' Left
  • Spinnin' And Spinnin'
  • Your Kiss Is Sweet
  • Heavy Day
  • Cause We've Ended As Lovers
  • Waiting For The Postman
  • Universal Sound Of The World

An excellent addition for collectors of Stevie Wonder, Motown, soul, funk, and 1970s R&B.

Condition

Vinyl: G

  • Excellent gloss
  • Light cosmetic sleeve marks only
  • No deep scratches observed
  • Clean labels
  • Plays should be very enjoyable

Jacket: Worn (W)

  • Noticeable water damage along upper front
  • Ring wear
  • Edge wear
  • Bottom seam beginning to separate
  • Corner wear
  • Still structurally intact

Please examine all photos carefully as they are part of the description.

Side Two
